summary: @servicetitan/widget-platform 5.6.7 executes obfuscated Bun payload at preinstall
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that runs on `npm install`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscator.io-style renamed (fs/https imported as `_0x488df8`/`_0x52943e`, per-callsite indirection maps) and downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from oven-sh's GitHub releases (with an Alpine/musl detection branch), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it 0o755, and execFileSyncs it against a sibling `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW` shift routine, `hc1jfK9` custom alphabet decoder over a large mixed-int/char literal table) and hex-mangled identifiers; it is not listed in the package.json `files` field, has no documented purpose, and is only reachable via the Bun dropper. Fetching a second general-purpose runtime at install specifically to execute an opaque, heavily obfuscated local payload — bundled in a package published under the ServiceTitan npm scope alongside a benign-looking React widget library — is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape and bypasses inspection by Node-based scanners. Installing this version runs attacker-controlled code on the installer host at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
